file_roles.evidence: QMenu::event now calls windowHandle()->setTransientParent(d->transientParentWindow()) when the menu is a window with no transient parent; new QMenuPrivate::transientParentWindow() computes it.

rationale: Parentless QMenu popups had no transient parent, so gnome-shell placed them at the top-left. The fix sets one in qmenu.cpp.
